problem: DevSystem currently retries the same stale frozen-registry verification and converts no registry progress into a hard failure, creating false-red cascades during legitimate cross-workstream registry lag.
root_cause: Steps 1 and 2 can now identify a legitimate inherited thaw and the need for registry reconciliation, but the shared DevSystem workflow still uses the old verify/sleep/verify loop and has no WAIT state with a single state-change resume budget.
patch: Add a read-only WAIT + one-resume contract and wire it into the frozen DevSystem registry gate under one exact-head thaw. A legitimate inherited thaw enters WAIT_REGISTRY_RECONCILIATION; only authoritative registry state-hash movement permits one resume and one frozen verification. Unchanged state never reruns proof, a second resume is forbidden, and unauthorized drift remains a hard failure. Shared registry state watching is centralized in devsystem/registry_wait_resume_gate_v1.sh so the focused proof and shared DevSystem path cannot drift.
